reviews.author: GrubbyPanda
reviews.body: I loved this pizza. My honest opinion is that the crust was a little dense, but not the worst gf pizza crust I've had.

reviews.author: GrubbyPanda
reviews.body: Great pizza, but I had stomach issues after eating here

reviews.author: Maya R.
reviews.body: Told the server I'm celiac. The cook came out, changed gloves and used a separate tray. Crust was crisp and chewy.

reviews.author: Devon
reviews.body: Good pie. I asked about the oven and got two different answers from staff, so I'd call ahead.

reviews.author: Priya K.
reviews.body: Pepperoni was great. GF crust is a little dense but tasty.

reviews.author: Sam
reviews.body: Simple and fresh. They brought the dressing on the side when I asked.

reviews.author: Lin
reviews.body: Broth was rich. One server said the noodle baskets are shared; another said they have separate ones.

reviews.author: Jordan
reviews.body: Bun held together well. Staff knew exactly what I meant by cross-contact.

reviews.author: Alex T.
reviews.body: Fries come from a fryer used only for potatoes. They confirmed it without me pushing.

reviews.author: Beehive Burger Co.
reviews.body: Our fryer is used only for potatoes, and we filter the oil daily.

reviews.author: Riley
reviews.body: Fluffy pancakes, and the toaster for GF bread is labeled.

reviews.author: Nadia
reviews.body: Delicious. I skipped the naan since they weren't sure about the tandoor.

reviews.author: Chris B.
reviews.body: Grilled chicken was juicy. They left the croutons off without me asking twice.

reviews.author: Morgan
reviews.body: Great fries, but the cashier confirmed they share oil with the breaded chicken, so I passed.

safetyProfiles.conflictNote: 2 reports disagree about whether GF pizzas bake in the same oven as regular pizzas.
Reports disagree about whether rice noodles are cooked in baskets also used for wheat noodles.
2 reports disagree about whether tortilla chips share a fryer with flour items.
1 report says GF buns were toasted on the shared grill; the restaurant says they use a separate pan.
Reports disagree about whether naan and tandoori dishes share the tandoor.
